description: PRIMARY EDIT TOOL. Run a natural-language video edit end-to-end. The backend agent plans, executes, verifies, and exports. Accepts anything from a one-liner ("generate 3 viral clips with captions and export") to a multi-paragraph creative brief. Returns the final mp4 URL synchronously when an export is queued. For long renders you may prefer queue_edit + check_job_status.

assets.description: Optional asset descriptors. Each item: { id?, type: "video"|"image"|"audio", url|src, mimeType?, duration? }.

attachedImages.description: Optional base64-encoded reference images the agent should consider while planning.

brandId.description: Optional brand-profile id to apply for this call (palette, fonts, logo, voice, gradeBias). Look up ids via list_brand_kits. Overrides project default brand.

captionTemplatePreset.description: Optional caption template slug to apply when (re)generating captions. One of 41 builtins (hormozi, mrbeast, viral-pop, minimal-pro, karaoke, neon-pop, typewriter, pop-wave, subtitle-bar, creator-box, …) or a user-saved template id from list_caption_templates.

core_only.description: If true, response carries only rendering-essential scene fields (no debug metadata).

editedPlan.description: Optional pre-edited plan object returned by a prior awaiting_approval response.

flaggedIssues.description: Optional list of specific user-flagged problems for this run (e.g. ["caption #3 misspelled"]).

projectBrandId.description: Optional default brand for the project. Persists; per-call brandId overrides.

project_id.description: Optional project id for tracking / continuity.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose into multiple calls.

requirePlanApproval.description: If true, the agent stops after planning and returns { status: "awaiting_approval", workingMemory, plan } without mutating. Resume by re-calling with the returned workingMemory + an approval prompt ("yes", "approve", "do it").

scene.description: Optional existing scene/timeline state to continue editing (advanced).

video_url.description: Optional source video URL. Auto-seeded as the starting layer when no scene is provided.

workingMemory.description: Working-memory snapshot returned by a prior call (typically one that returned awaiting_approval). Re-sending resumes that run.

name: autonomous_edit
